test_title: PYST 22: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the primary objective of the Dx-EDGE initiative launched in 2025?

options.text: To provide financial subsidies to large corporations
To promote foreign investments in India
To empower MSMEs with digital tools and knowledge

solution:
The correct answer is __**To empower MSMEs with digital tools and knowledge**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dx-EDGE Initiative:** The primary objective of the **Dx-EDGE initiative** launched in **2025** is to empower **Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)** by equipping them with advanced **digital tools** and providing necessary **knowledge and resources** to enhance their productivity and competitiveness. This is the correct answer.
 
• The initiative focuses on promoting **digital transformation** among MSMEs to help them compete effectively in the global and domestic markets.
 
• MSMEs form the backbone of the Indian economy, contributing significantly to **GDP**, **employment generation**, and **exports**. Hence, empowering them with digitalization is crucial.
 
• The program aims to foster innovation, improve operational efficiency, and enhance market access for MSMEs through the use of **digital technologies**.
 
• By leveraging digital tools, MSMEs can automate processes, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction, ensuring their sustainable growth.
 
• The initiative includes **training programs**, **workshops**, and **collaborations** with technology providers to facilitate digital adoption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About MSMEs:**

 
 
• **Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)** are enterprises defined by their investment in equipment and annual turnover under the **MSME Act, 2006**.
 
• They contribute to approximately **30% of India’s GDP** and nearly **50% of its exports**.
 
• MSMEs play a significant role in **employment generation**, especially in rural and semi-urban areas.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Digital Tools for MSMEs:**
 
 
• Adopting **digital technologies** allows MSMEs to access broader markets, improve customer engagement, and reduce operational costs.
 
• Technologies like **AI**, **Big Data**, **IoT**, and **cloud computing** enable data-driven decision-making and innovation.
 
• Digital platforms and e-commerce help MSMEs expand globally and cater to diverse customer bases.
 
 
 
• **Other Options Explained:**
 
 
• **Option 1:** Providing financial subsidies to large corporations is incorrect as the Dx-EDGE initiative is focused on MSMEs, not large corporations.
 
• **Option 2:** Promoting foreign investments in India is not the primary goal of this program. While foreign investments are crucial for economic growth, Dx-EDGE specifically targets MSMEs for their digital transformation.
 
• **Option 4:** Regulating e-commerce businesses is not the objective of Dx-EDGE. Regulation typically involves policy formulation, not empowerment through digital tools.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Government Support for MSMEs:**

 
 
• The government of India has launched several initiatives to support MSMEs, including the **Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan** and **Startup India**.
 
• Financial schemes like **PMEGP** (Prime Minister's Employment Generation Program) and **MUDRA Yojana** provide funding to MSMEs.
 
 
 
• **Challenges Faced by MSMEs:**
 
 
• **Lack of digital infrastructure** and **limited financial resources** hinder MSMEs from adopting advanced technologies.
 
• **Skill gaps** and **limited knowledge** about digital tools also act as barriers.
